segments.source: Two electronically adjustable grinders are the GIGA 6's defining advantage for a household that actually switches or blends beans. Two fluid systems also support more ambitious coffee-and-milk sequencing than a simple single-path automatic. This is a large, discontinued platform, however, and the dated North American purchase reference was a factory-refurbished Aluminum NAA unit. Condition, included warranty and exact regional menu therefore need as much attention as the twin-grinder hardware. Conflicting US and UK recipe counts should remain separate.
